authority: Film Core remains the formal fact source; ChatGPT output is untrusted proposal input.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search authorized FilmOS project
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find FilmOS project objects by text inside the currently authorized project.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch an authorized FilmOS object
tools.description: Use this when the user selected a stable FilmOS search result and needs its current read-only content.

tools.name: filmos_get_project_context
tools.title: Read FilmOS project context
tools.description: Use this when the user needs the authorized project's current units, shots, versions, state hash, blockers, or progress.

tools.name: filmos_get_content_unit_context
tools.title: Read FilmOS content unit
tools.description: Use this when the user needs one authorized ContentUnit and its formal state axes.

tools.name: filmos_get_shot_context
tools.title: Read FilmOS shot
tools.description: Use this when the user needs one authorized Shot, director-unit bindings, review state, and stable version.

tools.name: filmos_get_asset_version
tools.title: Read FilmOS asset version
tools.description: Use this when the user needs metadata for an authorized asset version without receiving a local path or original 4K media.

tools.name: filmos_get_scene_twin_summary
tools.title: Read SceneTwin summary
tools.description: Use this when the user needs authorized scene anchors, camera zones, fixed props, and current SceneTwin version.

tools.name: filmos_get_continuity_report
tools.title: Read continuity report
tools.description: Use this when the user needs an already recorded FilmOS continuity result; never run a new external generation.

tools.name: filmos_get_generation_attempts
tools.title: Read generation attempts
tools.description: Use this when the user needs recorded generation evidence and statuses; do not create or retry provider work.

tools.name: filmos_get_review_queue
tools.title: Read review queue
tools.description: Use this when the user needs Candidate and Review Draft items awaiting human review.

tools.name: filmos_get_blockers
tools.title: Read project blockers
tools.description: Use this when the user needs current STALE, BLOCKED, missing evidence, or authorization blockers.

tools.name: filmos_get_recent_changes
tools.title: Read recent FilmOS changes
tools.description: Use this when the user needs append-only audit changes from the authorized project.

tools.name: filmos_render_project_overview
tools.title: Render FilmOS project overview
tools.description: Use this after reading project context when the user benefits from a visual project summary.

tools.name: filmos_render_content_unit_progress
tools.title: Render FilmOS content unit progress
tools.description: Use this after reading a ContentUnit when the user benefits from a visual formal-state summary.

tools.name: filmos_render_shot_review
tools.title: Render FilmOS shot review
tools.description: Use this after reading a Shot when the user benefits from a visual read-only review card.

tools.name: filmos_render_asset_version
tools.title: Render FilmOS asset version
tools.description: Use this after reading asset metadata when the user benefits from a safe proxy-oriented version card.

tools.name: filmos_render_scene_twin
tools.title: Render FilmOS SceneTwin
tools.description: Use this after reading SceneTwin context when the user benefits from a spatial summary.

tools.name: filmos_render_review_queue
tools.title: Render FilmOS review queue
tools.description: Use this after reading the review queue when the user benefits from a visual Candidate and Review Draft list.

tools.name: filmos_render_proposal_export
tools.title: Render FilmOS proposal export
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a visual handoff form before preparing a signed proposal package.

tools.name: filmos_prepare_proposal_export
tools.title: Prepare FilmOS proposal export
tools.description: Use this only after the user asks to export a proposal package; it creates no FilmOS write and never approves or applies anything.
